faqs.question: Is Splitly really 100% free?
faqs.answer: Yes! Splitly is completely free with no pro subscriptions, daily limits, or hidden fees. Forever free, forever private, forever yours.

faqs.question: Where is my expense data stored?
faqs.answer: Your financial data is stored 100% locally inside your browser using IndexedDB. No backend server database ever collects or reads your expense data.

faqs.question: Can I use Splitly offline or install it as an app?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can add Splitly to your home screen with 1 tap for a full native app experience. Once added, it runs 100% offline without cellular or Wi-Fi connectivity.

faqs.question: How do temporary 24-hour share links work?
faqs.answer: When you choose to generate a share link, a temporary snapshot of your trip is encrypted and made accessible for 24 hours so friends can import it into their browser. After 24 hours, the server snapshot automatically self-destructs.

faqs.question: Can I export my trip data?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can export complete trip sessions as standard JSON or readable CSV spreadsheet files anytime from the settings tab.
